Processing Fee:
• Rs.500/- for General Category and Rs.350/- for SEBC / EWS / SC / ST / PH Category.
• Processing fee must be paid through Demand Draft only.
• Demand Draft must be in favour of “Registrar, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh”
Notes:
• The validity of the contract is 11 months or availability of permanent staff/sanctioned post amongst whichever is earlier.
• Selection process will be through Personal Interview.
• University may relax above or any other criteria given for all positions for suitable candidates, if required.
• The experience for the post for which the candidate is applying should be after completing his / her basic eligibility
qualification.
Page 3 of 3
General Instructions:
Applications are invited for the appointment of above contractual posts on purely temporary basis for
11 months in absence of regular sanctioned post. The validity of the contract is 11 months or availability of
permanent staff/sanctioned post amongst whichever is earlier. Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University is not
bound to provide any employment after completion of contract period.
1. The candidate must apply offline mode. Only offline application with required enclosures in one
copy will be accepted.
2. The application should be reached to University on or before 20/05/2025 by Post / Courier / in person
only.
3. Incomplete application will not be accepted. All required documents must be self-attested with offline
application.
4. Original documents should be produced for verification at the time of interview.
5. All the recruitment will be carried out in accordance with the prevailing reservation policy of the
State Government.
6. Candidates who desire to apply for more than one post will be required to submit separate offline
applications on the prescribed format along with all the specified supporting documents and
additional application processing fee along with each application.
7. Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain in touch with the University
website: www.bknmu.edu.in for more updates.
8. Call letters and other correspondence for attending the interview, etc., will be sent to the eligible
candidates by email only.
9. Schedule of Personal interview will be informed to the candidate through email and will be uploaded
on the university website: www.bknmu.edu.in. Candidate has to pay processing fees by DD only
along with application form as mentioned against the post which is non-refundable in any
circumstances.
10. The University reserves the right to postpone or to fill in the less or more number of posts at its
discretion depending upon the requirement of the University.
11. Decision of the competent authority shall be final regarding any discrepancy in the recruitment for
the advertised posts.
12. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to the candidate to attend Interview.
13. Canvassing of any kind will not be tolerated and it will disqualify the candidature.
14. The above-mentioned dates for submitted offline application, submission and other recruitment
process be extended in any conditions.
15. In case of any dispute, any sue or legal proceeding by or against the University, Courts within whose
local Jurisdiction, Headquarter of the University is situated shall have the Jurisdiction.
